name: dress-l8-cellar-l4
note: Opus visual QA #35 (verbatim): "Kessler's cellar (L4 end tick 11768, 75.25,-1.75 / L5 start) sits alone on a featureless dark-green plane at the map edge." L4 end: the courier at the cellar door at the game camera. Look for: at least four dressing elements in frame (lit house or porch light, hedges, beds, clothes line, lamps, tree), a visible warm light point, nothing standing on the cellar's door/stair foot, no floating or sunk props, no bare lawn filling the frame.
